description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Warrior of Light
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Holy Chain (0~2), removed after using Holy Chain two times

description.name: Holy Chain Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Holy Chain level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Warrior of Light]

description.name: Holy Chain Level
description.text: Keeps track of Holy Chain level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Warrior of Light]
